In this new article, @emi_eaton & Nick Day explore how third-party teaching resources influence education by legitimizing & entrenching beliefs about #climatechange, energy, & environmentalism that align with fossil fuel industry interests in #Saskatchewan
https://t.co/SmRnE4dQdr

Time magazine has devoted an entire issue to #climatechange. They gave no room to deniers. They have no place in this conversation. The only conversation is how to act - and quickly. https://t.co/mavQ4JrI3s

The hard truths of #climatechange by the numbers
A set of troubling charts shows how little progress nations have made toward limiting greenhouse-gas emissions. https://t.co/I2zw9XY3kq

Sofia Ahlberg insists that important way to comprehend extremely complex phenomena like #climatechange or #energytransition is through the imaginary. Fiction allows us to think of energy transition as reimagining human relationship to energy.
#EnergyandScale
Happy to see more people agreeing that panic and anxiety are warranted and productive and necessary to tackle #climatechange. Hope is great, but there's no agency there. https://t.co/w1z3F5VOTI

Foremost #energyhist scholar Vaclav Smil doesn't quibble about what is required to tackle #climatechange: We Must Leave Growth Behind.
This is the key. Technology will not solve this problem. We must change our relationship to the idea of a growth economy.
https://t.co/RZoJKujLRI

These billboards have nothing to do with adaptation to #climatechange. They don't highlight complications & complexities. It's blatant promotion of & profiting from climate change.
@UAIberta missed an opportunity to support #ClimateStrike by removing them. https://t.co/RfsV6lAY4O

If you want action on #climatechange, you have a responsibility to show up today.
I'll be at #ClimateStrike in #Saskatoon #YXE starting at noon at City Hall.
Where will you say you were?
https://t.co/a6cdIDAHvA? #FridaysforFuture

California wildfires are destroying electric grid infrastructure and causing blackouts. As #climatechange intensifies, decarbonization and #energytransition will become a whole lot messier. More delay means even greater challenges.
https://t.co/SG5hsRqJRn

#ClimateChange is the issue of our times. The results of #elxn43 make me ashamed to be Canadian, because this country will continue to be a major contributor to global emissions. 158 Liberal seats and 120 Conservative seats is a disaster for our planet's future. #burnbabyburn

@Ian_Mosby The Liberals have done nothing to meet Paris targets. In Canada, it's a dead letter unless something pretty significant changes. From my perspective, over 2/3 of Canadians voted against meaningful action on #ClimateChange.
#elxn43

Then imagine the Liberals, NDP & Greens worked together to govern the country? I could imagine some meaningful action on #ClimateChange in this country then.
There would also need to be a way to ensure a fair representation of rural interests. Prop Rep skews to urban interests.
Bipartisan support for meaningful action on #climatechange in New Zealand results in passage of Zero Carbon bill. https://t.co/YjlpR8uZTp

Great piece by Brett Dolter outlining what serious action on #climatechange in Canada could look like to initiate a net zero-emissions #energytransition and the political action needed to get it done.

Not sure this qualifies as "opinion" though.. https://t.co/XhDvOuDSvB
If you voted for the Liberals, you voted against meaningful action on #climatechange

Here it is folks. Read this and then let's agree that the most meaningful action industrialized countries can take on #climatechange is to reign in and place unprecedented constraints of the fossil fuel industry. https://t.co/7jXv8ZgeJw

New report makes it clear that there is no more time to waste, Canada must place unprecedented constraints on the oil and gas industry if it has any chance of taking meaningful action on #climatechange. If this is not done, there is no chance of meeting national GHG targets.
Interesting study reveals Canadian attitudes towards #energy and #climatechange more fragmented than polarized. https://t.co/5DUKIJ910y #Cdnpoli

Flying is bad news. The carbon emissions are, for many people, the greatest share of their carbon budget. Frequent flying has got to stop for there to be any chance of avoiding catastrophic #climatechange.
https://t.co/M7HLtR4oPo

Meaningful action on #climatechange requires significant constraints placed on oil and gas industry and incredible subsidies toward renewable energy. There is no way to avoid a +2C warming scenario without reigning in the giant companies that obstruct change.

If you oppose the violent removal of members of the #Wetsuweten nation from their unceded land to build a pipeline that will accelerate #climatechange, consider signing this petition intended for senior federal government cabinet ministers. https://t.co/1hVGBI29bi

By invading #Wetsuweten territory and arresting locked-out Unifor workers fighting for their pensions, violent police action prevents us from taking meaningful action on #climatechange. Important piece by @emilyjaneriddle
 https://t.co/BY08Ry60ZO

The #TeckFrontier tar sands project is the point of no return for Canada and the Liberals. If its approved, this country will have committed to a course of catastrophic #climatechange https://t.co/HHIwOyKMD4
There is no scenario in which #TransMountain & #CoastalGasLink pipelines & #TeckFrontier tarsands mine don't continue pushing global #climatechange past a catastrophic tipping point.

Woah. This is really big news (if it's not just a fake, or a smoke screen to get a better deal from uncertain federal government).

Teck has decided to withdraw its application to develop #TeckFrontier tarsands, citing lack of meaningful plans to address #climatechange in Canada.

Incredible.
JP Morgan, the world’s largest financier of #fossilfuels has warned clients that #climatechange threatens the survival of humanity.

Economists are turning against fossil fuel energy. https://t.co/GGEcT1oWiW

Telling people on the frontlines of #climatechange to remain positive, to retain hope, because a growing social movement is slowly getting our oppressors to change some of their behaviours is not true hope.  https://t.co/QHqJw4v1wO
